name: Luis Royo style Z-Image Turbo edition
description: New version of my Luis Royo's style lora, this time for Z-Image Turbo. He is a legendary spanish artist that published some of his works in the well known Heavy Metal magazine, but his work is much more extensive and cover all types of fields, especially in traditional fantasy, science fiction and erotic fantasy. The recommended strength for this lora is between 0.8 and 1, with the best results obtained at 0.8-0.9. Details start to shine at resolutions of 1440x1440 and above. This time, no trigger word is needed.
